description:
Retrieve a list of appManagementPolicy objects.

TIP: Lists app management policies. These policies restrict credential types and lifetimes for app registrations and service principals. Each has displayName, isEnabled, restrictions (passwordCredentials, keyCredentials with restrictForAppsCreatedAfterDateTime and maxLifetime). Useful for enforcing credential hygiene.
